moworks.notes: Target moves 0 → 1 on stiffness 280, damping 28, mass 1 (damping ratio 0.84): 0.8 % overshoot, within 1 % by ~260 ms. Kit form: springk(280, 28) over 0.26 s. Rule: the modal-presentation spring, barely past then settled. Small demo: the target moves 102 px beside the response graph, with overshoot and settle readouts. Params: stiffness (280) · damping (28) · duration (0.26 s). The modal-presentation spring (280 / 28): barely past (0.8 %), settled by ~0.26 s.
